name: South Tide's Run
summary: South Tide's Run follows Silverpine Forest's southwestern edge beside the cold Great Sea. These damp shores border the forested interior and form the southern counterpart to North Tide's Run.

sections.title: The Western Shore
sections.body: Along Silverpine Forest's southwestern edge, the Great Sea meets a desolate shore. The eastern roads lead toward the Greymane Wall under the forest's protection, but this open coastline takes the western tides. The bleak stretch remains largely untouched by the settlements inland.

faq.q: Where is South Tide's Run located?
faq.answer: South Tide's Run runs along Silverpine Forest's southwestern coast beside the open Great Sea.

faq.q: How does South Tide's Run differ from North Tide's Run?
aliases: north tides run vs south tides run
faq.answer: Both beaches trace Silverpine Forest's western shore. South Tide's Run covers the southern coast, while North Tide's Run follows the northwest near the border with Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Are there any settlements along South Tide's Run?
aliases: who lives in south tides run
faq.answer: No major towns or outposts stand along the beach. Most Forsaken activity stays inland near the main thoroughfares, leaving the shoreline isolated.

angles.text: As an Undead, you stand on a wild southwestern coast far from the Sepulcher's protection, an empty frontier the Forsaken rarely tread.
